scope: Twelve existing illustrations examined at source resolution and after matte removal. No newly drawn body, no new movement animation and no full-franchise lore certification.
mirrorBoundary: Reflection is approved only for approximate target-facing presentation of this exact unarmed drawing. It does not certify the unseen physical side, scars, lighting or source-game animations. Preserve one-sided mutations and weapons by using independent artwork instead.
